description: This file defines the class PermissionSubjectsMap, a specialized data structure implementing a weighted binary relation between permissions and authorization subjects. It provides methods to manipulate, query, and copy the relation, including adding total relations, intersecting, and union operations.

classes.name: PermissionSubjectsMap
classes.description: A class extending AbstractMap to represent a weighted relation between permission strings and subject ID strings, with various methods to manipulate and query the relation.

methods.name: addTotalRelationOfWeightZero
methods.description: Augments the relation with a total relation between provided permissions and subject IDs, setting their weight to zero.

methods.name: getMaxWeightForAllPermissions
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight among related permission-subject pairs for the provided permissions and subject IDs, or Optional.empty if none.

methods.name: getMaxNonemptyWeightForAllPermissions
methods.description: Returns the maximum weight if all permissions are related to some of the given subject IDs, otherwise Optional.empty.

methods.name: getSubjectUnion
methods.description: Returns a map representing the union of subjects related to a set of permissions, with maximum weights.

methods.name: getSubjectIntersect
methods.description: Returns a map representing the intersection of subjects related to all given permissions, with maximum weights.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the PermissionSubjectsMap.

methods.name: copyWithIncrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy of the relation with each pair’s weight incremented by one.

methods.name: copyWithDecrementedWeight
methods.description: Creates a copy with each pair’s weight decremented by one.

methods.name: removeAllEntriesFrom
methods.description: Removes all permission-subject pairs present in another PermissionSubjectsMap.
